instruction: Candid action photograph, medium full shot. Inside an indoor boxing gym, the dark-skinned boxer in red shorts (R2) on the left leans forward, throwing a body shot. The light-skinned boxer in black shorts (R1) on the right stands close, defending and clinching. The fighters are partially obscured by the black ropes of the boxing ring under bright overhead gym lighting.
